name: lockyt
title: Lock
description: Locks resolved issues and freeze articles on request. A locked issue or a frozen article is read-only. To edit it, reopen the issue or unfreeze the article first.

widgets.name: Lock
widgets.description: Sets who can reopen a locked issue or unfreeze a frozen article, and which changes stay permitted.

widgets.name: Lock status
widgets.description: Shows if the article is frozen. Freezes or unfreezes the article.

widgets.name: Lock status
widgets.description: Shows that a resolved issue is locked, and what the lock permits.
